breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the conflicting instruction: 'Employ a gamma‑centered Monkhorst‑Pack k‑point grid with a half‑grid shift.' This repeats the original error of combining gamma-centered sampling with a half shift, which are contradictory. The ground truth removes the half-shift instruction entirely, specifying only a gamma-centered k-point grid without any half-shift qualifier.
